name: archify
description: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams—self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.
one_liner: Turns a codebase or a plain description into professional, interactive diagrams and shareable images — no drawing required.
buyer: A solutions consultant or dev-agency lead who needs to hand a non-technical client a clear picture of what was built.
business_use_cases: A dev agency generates polished architecture diagrams for every client handoff instead of hand-drawn Miro boards.
A technical writer auto-generates before/after diagrams for release notes and change-review documents.
An engineering manager produces onboarding diagrams for new hires without needing a designer.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'diagram-as-a-service' add-on where clients pay per polished diagram set for investor decks or documentation.
Sell a hosted version with team sharing and version history for engineering orgs.

steal_this: Package it as a paid 'instant system diagram' add-on for freelance dev agencies to include in every project handoff this weekend.
